name: Dwarf Pension Scheme
benefit: A pension of ₹1,200/- per month is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be above 21 years of age. 1. The applicant’s height must be less than 4 feet. 1. There is no income limit for eligibility under the scheme.
